tasks.short: Supervise geothermal plant and well-field employees

steps.what: Check geothermal staffing, competence, current permits and immediate work conditions
Write the actual shift assignment board with named workers, locations and work limits
Brief, observe, coach and correct employees performing geothermal plant or well-field work

tasks.design: Reuse the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} assignment-board layout for recurring location and crew fields, retaining all worker selection and permit checks. The board is written separately from face-to-face supervision and its ordinary author save remains ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable board headings and location details may be re-entered on recurring shifts.
tasks.enabler_now: A native board template can supply stable structure without assigning or authorising work.
tasks.still_hard: Competence, changing plant hazards and actual employee performance need direct supervision.
tasks.human_edge: The manager intervenes when the real work differs from the plan.
tasks.altitude: Small reuse within an existing shift board.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: operations boards can retain recurring shift and location fields.

assumptions: Shares are illustrative hypotheses, not observations.
The assignment board already exists and employees read it; no new supervision log is introduced.
Board entry does not issue a permit, start equipment or replace safety authorisation.
unknowns: Whether the board is already templated
Frequency of changed crews and locations
research_questions: Is any repeated board structure still manually re-entered?

already_counted.description: Select workers and check current constraints in s1, and adapt the actual board in s2.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Reusing stable board fields removes 15*0.06=0.9 hours less 0.3 upkeep, net 0.6. Cautious case: a changing well-field crew permits only 0.4 hours of location-heading reuse, leaving 0.1 net; assignments and work limits are entered anew.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Oversee geothermal operations and maintenance compliance

steps.what: Read applicable standards and match them to actual geothermal operations and maintenance scope
Inspect operational and repair evidence for conformity with the applicable requirements
Direct corrective work and verify that operations and repairs meet the required standard
Enter the actual compliance inspection findings and evidence references in the maintenance record

tasks.design: Configure the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} maintenance inspection form to reuse asset identity and inspection headings, while the manager enters actual observations and evidence references. Physical oversight and corrective conversations remain separate; the internal inspection save neither releases equipment nor files a regulator report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring asset and inspection fields can be repeatedly typed into compliance records.
tasks.enabler_now: A native inspection form can reuse stable fields without certifying compliance.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting requirements and checking real repairs need technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides whether the observed evidence actually demonstrates conformity.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated inspection-form entry within human compliance oversight.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintenance systems can reuse asset fields and inspection-form structure.

assumptions: Shares and removed entry time are unmeasured hypotheses.
The maintenance inspection record already exists and is read for follow-up and audits.
No permit, equipment restart, regulatory submission or automatic compliance certification is included.
Any corrective work orders produced in a separate maintenance workflow are counted there, not invented here.
research_questions: Which inspection fields are repeated identity data rather than new findings?

already_counted.description: Enter and check actual findings, evidence references and corrected reused fields in s4.

incremental.description: Amortised inspection-form version checks against changed requirements.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Reused identity and headings remove 15*0.10=1.5 hours less 0.5 upkeep, net 1. Cautious case: a nonstandard repair requires bespoke inspection evidence and only 0.6 hours of asset identity entry is reusable, leaving 0.1 net; all findings and corrective oversight remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate geothermal plant conditions to employees

steps.what: Locate and verify the current geothermal plant conditions, timestamps and outstanding alarms
Write the existing employee condition bulletin with verified values and operating implications
Check the final condition bulletin, timestamp and employee recipients and approve circulation
outputs: approved bulletin version and employee recipients

steps.what: Circulate the approved plant condition bulletin to the approved employees
inputs: approved bulletin version and employee recipients

steps.what: Explain plant conditions to employees and answer their operational questions
outputs: employee understanding and clarified operating implications

tasks.design: Configure a native read-only {OPS_SYSTEM} historian view for the existing plant signals and reuse the current employee bulletin structure. Verify freshness and write operating implications manually, then approve the finished bulletin before separate circulation and the employee discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager can navigate several historian screens and recreate recurring bulletin structure.
tasks.enabler_now: A saved signal view and bulletin layout remove navigation and repeated headings without interpreting plant safety.
tasks.still_hard: Stale sensors, changing conditions and employees' questions require an informed person.
tasks.human_edge: The manager explains what the conditions mean for this shift.
tasks.altitude: Improve retrieval and an existing bulletin, retaining the actual briefing.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: plant historians can provide saved read-only signal views with timestamps.

assumptions: The modelled branch already uses a written condition bulletin read by employees; an oral-only briefing must be reweighted without it.
Signals are already captured by existing instruments and historian operation; no new manual capture is free.
Shares are hypotheses and lookup savings disappear if the view already exists.
The bulletin is not a permit or plant-control action; urgent safety communication is not delayed for this document path.
research_questions: How much of retrieval is screen navigation rather than verifying the actual conditions?

already_counted.description: Verify signals in s1 and adapt and check the actual bulletin in s2 and s3.

approvals.approved_version: s3 final bulletin version, observation timestamp and exact employee recipients; edits or stale conditions void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Saved navigation removes 20*0.15=3 hours and headings remove 15*0.10=1.5, less 0.7 upkeep gives 3.8 net. Cautious case: a sensor outage forces manual log verification and only 0.5 hours of navigation and 0.5 of bulletin structure can be removed, leaving 0.3 net; verification and explanation stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define comparable operating periods and verify geothermal equipment data, units and calibration context
Tabulate comparable output, consumption and downtime and calculate the agreed efficiency measures
Evaluate equipment, procedural and conditional causes and challenge misleading efficiency comparisons
Write and check the actual inefficiency findings, evidence and improvement options

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} historian exports and a fixed calculation sheet for measures whose periods, units and source signals the manager verifies in s1. Recompute and trace every number, leaving comparison repair, causal interpretation and the existing internal findings document with the manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated tabulation and identical efficiency arithmetic can be performed manually for each comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed query and calculation sheet can reproduce the same agreed measures from verified existing signals.
tasks.still_hard: Reservoir conditions, equipment changes and calibration differences can invalidate an apparent inefficiency.
tasks.human_edge: The manager distinguishes a genuine operational problem from an incomparable data series.
tasks.altitude: Automate repeated tabulation while retaining technical evaluation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed historian queries and spreadsheet formulas can tabulate operational efficiency measures.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured manual-tabulation branch; existing automatic dashboards cannot be credited again.
The historian already captures the signals; s1 counts selection, unit and source checks.
The internal findings document is already used to select improvement investigations; it is not an added log.
No control setpoint changes or maintenance releases are automated.
research_questions: Can the selected efficiency measures be reproduced with source-linked units and period boundaries?

already_counted.description: Validate inputs in s1 and manually repair failed mappings or misleading comparisons in s3 before writing findings.

incremental.description: Amortised query, unit conversion and calculation regression checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Repeated tabulation removes 20 hours less 1 upkeep, net 19. Cautious case: calibration breaks and changed operating regimes require manual reconstruction of most comparisons, leaving only 4 hours of stable-series tabulation removed and 3 net; extra repairs consume the remainder of the nominal benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use reliable existing plant information and modest record reuse while retaining plant supervision and technical judgement.
skills_to_grow: Keep communications distinct from control authorisation
role.ambitious_version: A geothermal manager works from traceable comparisons and current operating context while personally directing safe plant work.
